prompt: 在2023年6月22日社區活動中心雨後課堂活動中，在「1-Ⅳ-11：公共場所廣播」能力練習中，Which sentence best summarizes this message: 'Please bring a reusable bottle on Friday.'？

options.text: Students should bring a reusable bottle on Friday.
Students should bring a new desk on Monday.
The bottle is not allowed on Friday.
The message is about a school holiday.

answer.explanation: The summary keeps the item and the day stated in the message. 本題對應 KG「1-Ⅳ-11：公共場所廣播」，情境為2023年6月22日社區活動中心雨後。
